_about: Story axes for a fixed-answer mystery (story_gen.py). Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. decay:false keeps a value from being down-weighted by recent use. All text is our own.

question.v: whodunit: the party must name who did it
howdunit: who is plain, how it was possible is not
whydunit: the act is known, the reason is the puzzle
inverted: the players see the culprit first and must prove it
locked room: it could not have happened, and it did
heist in reverse: something was taken and the party must work out the plan

question: missing person: find them before the trail goes cold
the alibi that is too good: one story fits everything, and that is the problem
crime: a poisoning that did not kill
a broken seal on something sealed for good reason
victim: the head of a family business
a debt collector nobody will mourn
a stranger who arrived three days ago
a young apprentice with a bright future
a local official up for re-election
a performer at the height of their fame
a courier carrying something that was not theirs
the keeper of an important archive
a doctor who knew too many secrets
a beloved animal and, through it, its owner
culprit: a rival in the same trade
a guard on duty that night
motive: revenge for an injury years ago
fear of a secret coming out
a belief that this was right
ambition: the victim stood in the way
keeping a promise to someone dead
method: with a key they should not have had
by swapping two things that look alike
through a way in that the plans do not show
by making the time of it look different
with help from someone who did not know what they were helping
by staging it to look like an accident
using the victim's own habit against them
by being in two places through a stand-in
with something ordinary turned into a tool

twist.v: no twist: the clues mean what they seem to

twist: two people did it, each without knowing about the other
the victim set part of it up themselves
the crime the party is chasing hides a second, smaller one
the culprit is protecting the person the party suspects
the victim is not who everyone thought
the one who hired the party has something to hide
it was meant for someone else
the culprit has already confessed, to the wrong person
an innocent person has a reason to lie about where they were
red_herring: a suspect with a shameful but unrelated secret
an object that looks like the weapon and is not
a rumour that started as a joke
a witness who is honestly wrong about the time
a letter that seems to threaten but is about something else
a stranger seen nearby on unrelated business
a missing item that was only mislaid
clue_channel: bodies and objects: what things show if you look closely
talk: gossip, testimony, what people let slip
routine: who broke their habits that day
money: who paid whom, and when
the place itself: marks, dust, what was moved
animals and children, who notice and are not asked
time: clocks, schedules, the order things happened
setting_hook: a town cut off by weather
a celebration that cannot stop for this
an inheritance about to be read
an inspection due in two days
a funeral that brought everyone back
a market week with strangers everywhere
a building about to be torn down
a vote that the crime could swing
a household in mourning that wants this quiet
a journey where nobody can leave until it ends

suspects: a rival in the same trade
a guard on duty that night
suspicious: lied about where they were, for a reason of their own
was seen arguing with the victim
stands to gain from the outcome

cliches: a mysterious stranger in a long coat
